subject: AWS listing: integration surface + hero copy (next steps)
messages:
From: Emily Chan <emily.chan@acmecorp.com>

Date: 2028-06-18T09:12:00Z
Subject: AWS listing: integration questions and hero copy brainstorm
Attachments: acme-product-specs.pdf (application/pdf, 1.2MB)

Hey Jonas —

Thanks for the quick sync last week. We're starting the AWS listing setup and have a few open items where we need Redwood's input so we can finalize the product page and co-sell handoff: 

1) Integration surface: are there specific integration callouts we should include (e.g., VPC peering, private link, KMS)? We want to be precise to help buyers understand network requirements.

2) Hero value lines: we have a couple drafts but would like Redwood's preferred phrasing to avoid messaging drift with your GTM.

3) Private Offer / SKU model: timeline and any special footnotes (trial limitations, reserved capacity notes).

I'm attaching the product spec and customer flow we reviewed. Can you introduce the internal person(s) who will own copy + marketplace ops? If possible, we'd like a short mutual action plan (2–3 bullets) so we can move to listing draft before the end of next week.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-min call if that's easier.

Emily Chan
Head of Cloud Partnerships | Acme Corp
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0138

acme-product-specs.pdf: includes API endpoints, network diagrams, screenshots of admin UX.

From: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>

Emily — thanks for the clear ask and the spec. Looping in Kim (product marketing) and Marissa (marketplace enablement) to own copy and SKU ops.

Quick answers and proposed plan: 
- Integration callouts: we recommend calling out VPC endpoints (PrivateLink), KMS integration for key management, and our dedicated VPC mode for Private deployments. We'll give short copy snippets for each so the product page stays scannable.
- Hero line: suggest one short, bold line + 2 supporting bullets (see Kim's follow-ups).
- Private Offer / SKU: Marissa will propose SKU naming and trial footprint; note: reserved capacity commits should be documented in the Private Offer footnote (we usually add a one-line burst/cancel clause).

Next steps (mutual action plan):
1) Marissa to send SKU and trial footnote draft by EOD tomorrow.
2) Kim to share 2 hero copy options + 3 bullets by EOD Friday for your review.
3) I'll upload the checklist to the HubSpot deal and introduce the AWS marketplace case owner if PR/verification is needed.

If that timeline works, we'll treat the attached CSV as the source of truth for asset handoff (fields: asset name, file link, owner, required by).

Jonas Weber
Senior Partner PM | Redwood Inference

> Hey Jonas —
> 
> Thanks for the quick sync last week...

Emily / team — first pass copy attached. Two hero options below (short, scannable) plus supporting bullets tuned for AWS buyers. Pick the hero you prefer; I can iterate tone for the landing tile or the detail page.

Hero A (concise, product-first):
"High-throughput LLM inference with predictable costs and enterprise controls"
Bullets:
- Dedicated GPU pools with predictable throughput and SLAs
- VPC & KMS integrations for data isolation and encryption
- Smart routing & caching to reduce token costs

Hero B (outcomes-focused):
"Ship LLM features faster — low latency, predictable spend, enterprise-safe"
Bullets: same as above but reorder: latency, cost, controls.

Integration callouts (short snippets for the page):
- "Private VPC deployment via PrivateLink — no public ingress required."
- "Customer-managed KMS keys for data-at-rest encryption."
- "Reserved capacity and burst plans available via Private Offer."

Notes: For the AWS product description we should keep the hero under 90 characters and bullets under 140 characters each. I flagged optional longer descriptions in the attached doc for the product detail section.

Kimberly Park
Product Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference

listing_copy_v1.docx: contains hero A/B, 3x bullets, 2x longer description paragraphs, and meta tags for AWS SKU page (one-liner, short description, long description).

Emily — thanks for the spec and quick turnaround team. Quick operational notes and final snippets attached: 

1) SKUs / Private Offer: propose SKUs 'redwood-hosted' (metered), 'redwood-dedicated' (reserved), 'redwood-private' (VPC). Private Offer footnote: "Reserved capacity commitments billed monthly; trial applies only to metered SKU and limited to 10k tokens."

2) Co-sell handoff: we'll create a one-page enablement deck (link to HubSpot in related links) and assign an AM to coordinate field requests.

3) Final copy: I opted to go with Hero B (outcomes-focused) for the landing tile — attached are three micro-variants tuned for SEO and the AWS hero constraints. Please confirm which variant you prefer and we can lock assets for the listing submission.

Thanks — can also jump on a quick call to finalize screenshots and AM contact.

Marissa Cole
Marketplace Enablement Lead | Redwood Inference
